messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency increased 4.8x and 5xx rate spike (gateway+timeout) for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Trigger threshold crossed at 2026-03-15T09:02:25Z. Paging oncall group: @oncall-sre

alex: I'm on it, grabbing metrics + traces. Saw a deploy 09:00Z - tagging releases.

maya: I got paged, standing by. Can you post the deploy id?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: release=v2026-03-15-rc3, cluster=prod-usw2, rollout=canary->90%. Logs: "canary step succeeded" at 2026-03-15T08:59:30Z.

jordan: Graphs: CPU okay, but tail latencies jump with a pattern of connection waits -> timeouts. Also seeing increase in 502/504s at the gateway. Link: https://ops.redwood/graphs/incident/4465012345 (short link)

kai: Reproduced locally with a traffic replay script hitting canary. P95/P99 blow up at longer contexts. KV cache evictions increased around the same time.

luis: @alex @maya I'm checking downstream model-serving logs. There's a sharp increase in `invoke_latency_ms` and a correlative spike in `rpc retransmits`. Could be network flakiness or a change in the runtime path for long sequences.

alex: First mitigation: switch traffic routing to previous stable model variant and reduce canary to 0%. Initiating rollback of release v2026-03-15-rc3.

alex: Running rollback command: ```
# rollback canary
deployctl rollback --cluster prod-usw2 --release v2026-03-15-rc3 --to v2026-03-10-stable
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started. Canary traffic draining. Expected cutover 30s.

incident-bot: Update: error rate fell ~60% within 90s of rollback start. p99 decreased but still elevated vs normal. Continued monitoring.

maya: Turning on emergency autoscale for model-serving pods to handle inflight cold starts: ```
kubectl patch hpa model-inference -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'
```

jordan: Noting customer impact: ~11% of requests in us-west-2 hit 5xx/timeouts during the 09:00-09:05 window. Some API clients reported degraded response times. No global outage.

kai: Checking connection pools at gateway -> runtime. Found many connections in CLOSE_WAIT, and nginx upstream timeouts spiking to 30s. Suspect a regression in the runtime's keepalive handling introduced in rc3.

luis: I pulled a few runtime traces. There's a new code path for KV prefetch that sometimes stalls when the model context > 2048 tokens. Patch PR #4893 changed prefetch concurrency.

alex: Can we hotfix that toggle? If we flip prefetch back to conservative, might recover without full rework.

luis: I can flip the toggle via configmap. Patch applied: `prefetch.concurrency=2 (was 8)` at 09:06Z.

incident-bot: Telemetry: error rate dropped further to ~2.1% (baseline 0.3%). p99 trending down. Continue watch for 15m.

maya: Creating incident timeline + customer-notify draft. We'll update workspace and notify affected customers if metric persists >30m.

alex: Handoff to next oncall in 10m. Current mitigations: rollback completed, autoscale min replicas increased, prefetch concurrency reduced. Battle plan: (1) monitor until norm; (2) collect replay traces for rc3; (3) root-cause with runtime team.

jordan: Quick note for postmortem: tag events with deploy id, prefetch toggle changes, and gateway connection stats. Also include traffic distribution snapshot.

kai: I created a short grepable runbook entry: "if p99 spike post-deploy and KV evictions high -> reduce prefetch.concurrency, rollback release". Saved at https://ops.redwood/runbooks/runtime-prefetch.md

alex: handoff to @sre-oncall in 10m. Leaving command history and logs in thread.

alex: @sre-oncall you're on initial watch. Key alerts: p99 > 4x baseline or 5xx > 1% in any region -> escalate to sec-eng and runtime.

sre-oncall: ACK. Monitoring dashboard and traces. I'm on pager for the next 2h.

maya: Customer impact note posted to #customer-status: "Partial degradation for text generation in US-West between 09:00-09:07 UTC. Error rates reduced after rollback and hotfix. Follow-up planned."

luis: For RCA: will bisect rc3 changes tomorrow and run longer context load tests. Suspect PR#4893 concurrency tuning + canary rollout timing.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigated. Status=partial-mitigated. Actions: rollback to v2026-03-10-stable, prefetch toggle lowered, autoscale increased. Next: RCA + postmortem.

alex: Closing on-call shift now. Leaving notes for follow-up: collect flamegraphs for runtime hot paths, gather per-client error rates, confirm no residual impact on dedicated customers.

sre-oncall: Will continue 15m watch and then mark incident as resolved if metrics stabilize.

jordan: :thumbsup: Great job triaging quickly. We should add a scheduled long-run load test for any future topology changes.

maya: Adding trial checklist to PR template to avoid prefetch concurrency regressions.

incident-bot: Incident closed at 2026-03-15T09:35:00Z (status: monitoring)."
